name: Cheats - Health and Ammo
author: wolfsdk
description: Gives the normal campaign the values of the 999 mode: 999 starting health instead of 100, plus the flags FLAG_AMMOUNLIMITED (ammo is never used up) and FLAG_NOOVERCHARGE (health above 100 does not drain). Both are set exactly like this in gamemodesp:gamemode/999, so the game ships the flags itself. This route gets around the retail lock on g_infiniteAmmo because not a single cvar is touched. Full replacement instead of set, because gamemode/campaign has no gameModeFlags field at all and the decl editor does not add new fields. Untested in game: built and checked, but never launched.
